name: Holos Monorepo — Package Dependency Graph
description: Ground-truth, code-derived view of every app, package, and CLI tool in the Holos monorepo, connected by their actual workspace:* dependencies from package.json. Complements the conceptual tier view (alistigo-platform.arch.json) with the real package-level topology.

nodes.name: alistigo-artifact-playground
nodes.description: Two-page dev playground for Alistigo artifacts. Host page provides a Dev Config Form for configuring artifacts; iframe page renders the artifact in an isolated context that mirrors the Claude embedding environment.

nodes.name: @alistigo/artifact-claude-capabilities-demo-skill
nodes.description: Alistigo artifact-claude-capabilities-demo agent skill — demonstrates all Claude artifact iframe APIs

nodes.name: @alistigo/artifact-claude-capabilities-demo
nodes.description: Self-contained UMD bundle — a Claude artifact that demonstrates all Claude iframe APIs: storage, AI completions, file download, network proxy, and external navigation.

nodes.name: @alistigo/artifact-config-format
nodes.description: Aggregate config schema and TypeScript types for Alistigo artifacts — discriminated union combining base config with per-artifact schemas.

nodes.name: @alistigo/artifact-config-list-format
nodes.description: JSON Schema and TypeScript types for the Alistigo list artifact config.

nodes.name: @alistigo/artifact-core-components-react
nodes.description: Platform-level React UI components shared by all Alistigo artifacts — LoadingScreen, ErrorScreen, ArtifactContextMenuContainer, ArtifactInfoPanel. Built on Tailwind v4.

nodes.name: @alistigo/artifact-core
nodes.description: Shared lifecycle, phases, error boundary, and plugin integration for Alistigo artifacts.

nodes.name: @alistigo/artifact-list-checkbox-plugin
nodes.description: Checkbox domain-contribution plugin for @alistigo artifacts.

nodes.name: @alistigo/artifact-list-skill
nodes.description: Alistigo artifact-list agent skill (agentskills.io)

nodes.name: @alistigo/artifact-list
nodes.description: Self-contained UMD bundle of the Alistigo list widget — for Claude HTML artifacts and standalone pages. Includes React, Lingui, and all Alistigo packages; no external dependencies required.

nodes.name: @alistigo/artifact-manager-skill
nodes.description: Alistigo artifact-manager agent skill (agentskills.io)

nodes.name: @alistigo/artifact-manager
nodes.description: Artifact configuration management for Alistigo — reads, validates, and resolves artifact config at runtime.

nodes.name: @alistigo/artifact-plugin-api
nodes.description: Composable plugin interface, event bus, and CDN dynamic-import loader for @alistigo artifacts.

nodes.name: @alistigo/artifact-posthog-plugin
nodes.description: PostHog analytics plugin for @alistigo artifacts.

nodes.name: @alistigo/artifact-sentry-plugin
nodes.description: Sentry error-monitoring plugin for @alistigo artifacts.

nodes.name: @alistigo/artifact-user-plugin
nodes.description: User identity plugin for @alistigo artifacts — avatar generation via jdenticon.

nodes.name: @alistigo/claude-artifact-api
nodes.description: TypeScript types and inject script for the Claude artifact iframe API. Reverse-engineered from live Claude sessions.

nodes.name: @alistigo/claude-storage-plugin
nodes.description: Window.storage-backed AlistigoPlugin (type: storage) implementation for the Claude artifact runtime.

nodes.name: @alistigo/core-document
nodes.description: Base types and JSON schema for all Alistigo artifact documents.

nodes.name: @alistigo/explorer-components-react
nodes.description: React UI components for the Claude storage explorer artifact — KeyList, JsonDocumentViewer, StorageSection, StorageExplorerApp.

nodes.name: @alistigo/list-components-react
nodes.description: React presentational components for the Alistigo base list app — built on the repo's chosen stack (Tailwind v4 + Radix Primitives + Vaul + Motion + Lucide + Radix Colors + Lingui i18n). Pinned to the driver-playwright contract; ships its own Storybook for component review.

nodes.name: @alistigo/list-document
nodes.description: Specification, JSON schemas, and TypeScript types for the Alistigo list document format.

nodes.name: @alistigo/list-domain
nodes.description: Shared domain primitives and types for Alistigo — IDs, value objects, and core entities.

nodes.name: @alistigo/list-features
nodes.description: Gherkin behavior specifications for Alistigo AI. Source of truth for what the app should do; the runner reads these files to assert conformance.

nodes.name: @alistigo/local-storage-plugin
nodes.description: localStorage-backed AlistigoPlugin implementation (storage type) for standard browser contexts.

nodes.name: @alistigo/logger
nodes.description: Shared pino-based logger for Alistigo apps and packages. Wraps pino with a singleton root logger and a createLogger factory for named child loggers.

nodes.name: @alistigo/agent-skill-tester
nodes.description: CLI for evaluating skill trigger accuracy using labelled eval query sets.

nodes.name: @alistigo/core-document-validator
nodes.description: CLI to validate Alistigo document JSON files against the schema.

nodes.name: @alistigo/list-features-runner-playwright
nodes.description: Cucumber.js runner for Alistigo Gherkin features. Consumes .feature files from @alistigo/list-features and drives the app via Playwright in step definitions.

nodes.name: Developer / CI
nodes.description: Human developer or CI pipeline invoking CLI tools directly rather than importing them as libraries.

nodes.name: Claude / AI Agent
nodes.description: Claude or another AI agent that loads and uses agent skill packages (SKILL.md + api.json) at conversation time.
